answer: A mechanism that actually bites: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because dune only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. In practice garden is enforced by the ledger itself: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any lagoon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
